name: Shell command hidden behind dynamic imports

steps.action: Upload v1 (clean) and v2 (with the hidden /admin/run route)
Open the Security track and click the v2 node
steps.expected: The arrow into v2 is EXPANDING
"Runs system commands" is listed under What it can do

steps.action: Open the Findings tab and look for each hidden call
steps.expected: A high CWE-78 finding on each of the three command lines (42, 43, 44)
steps.actual: Caught 3 of 3: importlib + getattr(mod, "run"), __import__("os").system, sp.Popen (renamed import)

steps.action: Look for the dynamic import on line 41
steps.expected: importlib.import_module("sub" + "process") is flagged as hiding which module it loads
steps.actual: medium: Loads a module whose name is built at run time (subprocess) (silo.python.dynamic-import)
